# id: # Smithing methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: The Knight's Sword (quest)
note: One-off 12,725 Smithing xp, which the F2P guide says takes you from level 1 to 29; the quest needs two iron bars (Ironman guide); the UIM quest table lists 12,175 xp, which conflicts.
source: OSRS Wiki Free-to-play Smithing training; Pay-to-play Smithing training; Ironman Guide/Smithing; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Smithing 2026-11-11

name: Bronze platebodies (anvil)
where: Anvil south of Varrock west bank
note: 62.5 xp each from 5 bars (F2P guide), which gives 50,000 xp/h; the bar and platebody counts are our estimate (xp/h divided by xp each, 5 bars each); starts at 29 if The Knight's Sword is done.

name: Iron platebodies (anvil)
where: Anvil south of Varrock west bank
note: 125 xp each from 5 bars, 100,000 xp/h (F2P guide); the bar and platebody counts are our estimate.

name: Steel platebodies (anvil)
where: Anvil south of Varrock west bank
note: 187.5 xp each from 5 bars, 150,000 xp/h (F2P guide); the bar and platebody counts are our estimate.

name: Mithril platebodies (anvil)
where: Anvil south of Varrock west bank
note: 250 xp each from 5 bars, 200,000 xp/h (F2P guide); the bar and platebody counts are our estimate.

name: Adamant platebodies (anvil)
where: Anvil south of Varrock west bank
note: 312.5 xp each, up to 250,000 xp/h with energy potions (F2P guide); level 87 can be boosted to 88 with dwarven stout; the bars per item are not stated, and the platebody count is our estimate.

name: Rune platebodies (anvil, dwarven stout)
where: Anvil south of Varrock west bank
note: 375 xp each, up to 300,000 xp/h with a dwarven stout (+1 Smithing) and energy potions, but very expensive (F2P guide); the platebody count is our estimate.

name: Gold bars at the Blast Furnace (goldsmith gauntlets)
where: Blast Furnace in Keldagrim (official Blast Furnace worlds)
note: P2P guide table gives 380,000 xp/h with goldsmith gauntlets; the Ironman guide says 8,000-9,000 ore per hour is realistic, so the low end is used; Ordan ore purchases and Blast Furnace fees make it expensive.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Smithing training; Ironman Guide/Smithing; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Smithing 2026-11-11

name: Smelting bars at the Blast Furnace (iron to runite)
gives: iron bar=15:6000;steel bar=30:5400;mithril bar=50:3600;adamantite bar=70:2700;runite bar=85:2160
note: Figures are from the summarised part of the P2P guide and assume ice gloves, coal bag and 36 stamina doses per hour; the guide does not state ore or coal inputs per hour, and the Ironman guide says buying ores from Ordan and smelting here is the most efficient way to train.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Smithing training; Ironman Guide/Smithing; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Smithing 2026-11-11

name: Steel and mithril platebodies at the Blast Furnace
note: UIM guide (summarised part): about 65,000-75,000 xp/h for steel up to 68 and 100,000-110,000 for mithril from 68; it needs 25 inventory spaces and the guide says steel is only recommended up to 68.

name: Giants' Foundry sword commissions (bars, levels 15-50)
note: Default-mould xp/h from the Ironman guide summary, mapped to levels 15, 30 and 50 by the P2P table (bronze/iron, iron/steel, steel/mithril); best moulds give about 85,690, 118,850 and 154,840; uses is bronze and iron per hour at 15; members status is inferred.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Smithing training; Ironman Guide/Smithing 2026-11-11

name: Giants' Foundry Prifddinas armour (mithril and adamant)
where: Giants' Foundry, with armour bought from Aneirin's Armour in Prifddinas
note: UIM guide summary: about 160,000-165,000 xp/h with no moulds, up to about 250,000 at maximum efficiency; the Ironman guide says this is the best xp from 70 but does not profit.
source: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Smithing; Ironman Guide/Smithing; Pay-to-play Smithing training 2026-11-11

name: Steel cannonballs (ammo mould)
note: Ironman guide: 2,160 cannonballs and 13,824 xp/h; a double ammo mould doubles both (27,648 xp/h); the steel bar figure is our estimate from 4 cannonballs per bar (summarised P2P section).
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Smithing training; Ironman Guide/Smithing 2026-11-11

name: Dart tips at the anvil (iron from level 19)
note: Figures are without Smiths' Uniform from the summarised P2P section (1,060 bars per hour, 10 tips per bar, so the tips count is our estimate); the same table covers steel, mithril, adamant and rune tips; members status is not stated.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Smithing training; Ironman Guide/Smithing 2026-11-11

name: Zalcano (smithing from ore)
note: Ironman guide says about 3,000 Smithing xp/h while fighting; the P2P guide gives no representative rate; the activity yields gold ore, mithril and adamantite.
